meta.source: Eskom/NTCSA Weekly System Status Report, 2026 Week 37, "Estimated Rooftop PV" provincial table, Aug-26 row. Verbatim except Northern Cape 758.4, split to Hydra Central on the 82/18 ratio used since the Jun-26 figure. REPLACED the Jul-26 row on 17 Sep 2026 - rule 5, replace the whole block rather than adding the delta. Aug-26 moved only two provinces: Eastern Cape 680.2 -> 797.1 and Free State 556.6 -> 650.2, +210.5 MW in total, with the other seven unchanged. NOT ALL ROOFTOP: NTCSA's own footnote puts every PV installation without an NTCSA contract in this line, ground-mounted included, so an unknown slice is grid-connected plant rather than behind-the-meter. See the KNOWN DISTORTION block at index.html:5744.
meta.caveat: Eskom footnotes this series: "Rooftop PV includes ground-mounted as well as all other PV installations that do not have contracts with NTCSA." The bucket is contractual, not physical, so an unknown slice is ground-mounted grid-connected plant being modelled as demand suppression. The provincial split shows it: the Northern Cape carries 583 W per person against Gauteng 190, in a province with few roofs and every large solar farm.
